paragraphs: Mentioned in the old Midrash Tehillim, chapter 75: R' Yudan, R' Nechemyah bar Chanina and R' Yitzchak bar Chiya. Buber's edition has a different reading.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פע״ה is contextually chapter/psalm 75 and מ׳ בובר the Buber Midrash/edition, without a freshly verified edition or numbering. Old remains Hyman’s descriptive label.
Hyman does not supply the contents of the different reading; none is invented or used to harmonize the three names. All four personal-title occurrences remain R', with no canonical identity links.
